image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of three figs on a white surface. Two figs are sliced in half lengthwise, revealing the pink, seed-filled interior and green-to-purple skin gradient. One whole or partially visible fig sits in the background. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the moist texture of the fruit's flesh.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pear-shaped fruit with soft, thin skin in green, purple, or brownish coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin clearly transitions from green at the top to deep purple/brown at the base, matching the description perfectly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Smooth to slightly wrinkled texture with matte finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The exterior skin appears smooth with a natural matte/semi-gloss finish typical of fresh figs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated pear shape with tapered form from broad base to narrow stem end.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The cross-sections confirm the classic teardrop/pear shape of the fig.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small ostiole (eye) at bottom of fruit.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The figs are sliced longitudinally; the bottom tip (ostiole) is either cut off or not facing the camera in a way that allows verification.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Narrow stem end contrasting with broad rounded base.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tapering geometry from the stem neck down to the bulbous body is clearly visible in the slices.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thin, easily bruised skin covering soft interior.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin layer is visibly thin relative to the pulp volume, consistent with fig anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cut cross-section reveals hollow interior filled with numerous tiny seeds.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The interior is densely packed with small, distinct seeds embedded in the pulp.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Sweet, pink to amber-colored fleshy pulp surrounding seeds.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The pulp is a vibrant pinkish-red near the center fading to amber/white near the skin, matching the biological description.
The visual cues of moisture and the slight collapse of the internal structure suggest a soft, ripe texture.

selected_experts.reason: Primary expert to confirm the specific botanical identity of the fruit as a fig and rule out look-alikes.
To analyze the complex seed/pulp texture for any AI-generated smearing, repetition, or unnatural patterns.
To verify the sharpness of the boundary between the skin and the white background, checking for haloing or bleeding.
To ensure the spatial relationship between the foreground slices and the background fig is physically consistent.

focus_areas: Moisture/reflection consistency on the cut surfaces
Edge sharpness against the white background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the seed patterns. AI often fails to generate truly random, distinct seeds, resulting in 'noise' textures or repeating patterns. Verify if the seeds have individual definition or if they melt into the pulp. Also, check the skin thickness consistency around the curve of the fruit.
